##### Project general facts

ZEN is a premium oceanfront residence, offering a collection of studios, apartments, and smart villas. Designed as a turnkey investment product, each residence comes with a clear entry price, a defined target audience, and built-in professional management. The property operates as part of a larger hotel ecosystem, ensuring that owners benefit from higher occupancy rates, premium rental income, and enhanced future resale value.

ZEN offers a complete ecosystem where residents can live, relax, and work without ever leaving the complex. The property features a retail zone with boutiques, a premium supermarket, and a pharmacy, a recovery zone including Bali’s first onsen, a spa, yoga space, gym, pilates studio and Japanese garden, multiple on-site restaurants and cafes, a coworking and event space, and a full-day kids club with kindergarten, pool and rope park. This level of resort-style living ensures stable occupancy and income year-round.

Every residence at ZEN is delivered fully furnished and equipped in the signature Zen design, blending modern tropical aesthetics with Japanese minimalism. Studios feature ergonomic open-plan layouts with a bedroom, living area, kitchen, and private bathroom. Apartments include private mini-pools on terraces, and separate bedrooms with walk-in closets. Smart villas offer panoramic bedrooms, spa-level bathrooms, and private rooftop lounges with pools, sun loungers, and BBQ areas, creating unique rental products that command premium rates.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Melasti area of Uluwatu within the prestigious "Pink Zone," this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali’s most sought-after coastal districts. The area is renowned for its stunning beaches, dramatic cliffs, and world-class surf breaks, attracting over a million tourists annually. With a scenic walking area leading to the ocean, the location offers effortless access to the island’s most beautiful coastline.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning and mature tourism infrastructure. Melasti is home to some of Bali’s most iconic beach clubs, luxury resorts, and fine dining establishments, creating a vibrant yet serene atmosphere. The area’s designation as a tourism zone ensures full legal compliance for short-term rentals and hospitality operations, making it an ideal setting for premium real estate investment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies oceanfront luxury, natural beauty, and strong investment fundamentals, Melasti delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, five-star amenities, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, sophisticated and strategically positioned for long-term value.
